tbesh_html:
1) to strip, strip off, lay bare, make bare, draw out
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to strip off
1a2) to strip, lay bare
1a3) to draw (water), skim, take from the surface

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked (for exertion or in disgrace), to drain away or bail up (a liquid)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: make bare, clean, discover, draw out, take, uncover.
